sloka: सत्त्वे वीर्ये न ते कश्चित् समो वानर विद्यते ।यदवप्लुत्य विस्तीर्णं सागरं पुनरागतः ।। 5.57.45 ।।।।
transliteration: sattve vīrye na te kaścit samo vānara vidyate ।yadavaplutya vistīrṇaṁ sāgaraṁ punarāgataḥ ।। 5.57.45 ।।।।

translations.english: "O vanara you have leaped such a wide ocean and have returned. In strength and valour. There is none equal to you.
